elements.text:
from dowhy import CausalModel

model = CausalModel(
    data=df_pd,
    treatment='has_brand',
    outcome='price',
    common_causes=['category',
                   'item_condition'])
)
identified = model.identify_effect()
estimate = model.estimate_effect(
    identified,
    method_name='backdoor
      .propensity_score_matching')
print(f'ATE: {estimate.value}')
